Description: System initializes StateGraph with 'planner' and 'executor' nodes.
EventBus transmits 'USER_MESSAGE' from UI to Agent.
EventBus transmits 'AGENT_SPEAK' and 'AGENT_THINKING' to UI.
Router Logic: If plan status is 'failed', route back to Planner (Self-Correction).
Router Logic: If steps remain, route back to Executor (Loop).
Router Logic: If 'pendingAction' exists, pause execution (End state).
Planner receives user input + context and outputs structured JSON plan.
Planner parses JSON response using 'Greedy' regex fallback if standard parse fails.
Planner receives 'lastError' in context during Repair Mode.
Executor executes the specific tool defined in the current plan step.
Executor detects sensitive tools (write_file, rm) and halts for approval.
Executor handles 'Approved' signal and resumes execution.
Executor handles 'Rejected' signal and marks step as failed.
run_terminal_command: Executes shell commands (ls, npm, node).
write_file: Writes content to file (uses 'node -e' workaround).
search_text: Greps file content (uses 'node -e' workaround).
find_file: Fuzzy searches filenames via MiniSearch.
navigate_to_code: Highlights lines in Monaco Editor.
change_tab: Switches sidebar tab programmatically.
toggle_diff_mode: Enables/Disables diff view.
AgentState (Plan, Chat, PendingAction) saved to localStorage on change.
loadSession() restores State and emits 'AGENT_SESSION_RESTORED'.
Chat Interface renders User and AI messages.
Chat Interface renders Markdown and Code Blocks correctly.
Plan Sidebar renders live plan progress (Active/Pending/Done).
Permission Modal appears when 'AGENT_REQUEST_APPROVAL' is emitted.
Voice Synthesis (TTS) speaks agent responses (if enabled).
Terminal View streams 'RUNTIME_OUTPUT' events in real-time.
Diagram Parser extracts §filepath:line syntax from Mermaid node labels.
Diagram Renderer renders interactive nodes with .clickable-ref CSS class and hover effects.
Clicking a diagram node triggers MapsToCode with specific file and line focus.
NavigationService fetches the full Git Tree (recursive) from GitHub API on demand.
System maintains a 'Hybrid State' merging prFiles (Hot) with repoTree (Ghost).
FileTree provides a toggle to switch between 'Changes Only' and 'Full Repository' views.
Clicking a 'Ghost Node' (non-PR file) triggers a lazy fetch of file content (Base64 decode).
Code Viewer displays a 'Read Only' badge/lock icon for lazy-loaded files.
Spec Engine adapts requirements (Linear/Markdown) into granular SpecAtoms.
Director outputs 'Dual-Track' JSON: { voice, screen } to separate conversational summary from technical code.
Live Context Stream: The UserContextState updates in real-time (cursor position, selection, active tab) without triggering an LLM call.
Smart Context Snapshot: When the user sends a message, the payload includes the history of the last 3 files touched, not just the current one.
Barge-In Handling: If the user types or selects code while the Agent is "Speaking" (rendering), the Agent pauses and acknowledges the new context.
Bi-Directional Highlight: Agent execution (e.g., Maps_to_code) does not steal focus if the user is actively typing (Focus Locking).
Context Debounce: Rapid file switching (< 500ms dwell time) is ignored by the Context Stream to prevent "Flicker".
API Rate Limit: System must handle 429 errors gracefully.
Response Time: Planner should generate plan < 10s.
Sandbox: Agent cannot access host system files (Browser Isolation).
Debug Snippet dumps full state JSON to console.
LangSmith Tracing records token usage and latency.
Ghost File Fetch Latency: Lazy loading a file < 1MB must complete in < 2s.
Repository Tree Caching: The full file tree is fetched once per session/SHA to prevent API rate limiting.
Voice-Code Separation: TTS must NEVER read raw code blocks or Markdown symbols aloud.
